raw_packet.full_request: 공공기관과 작은 데이터 기업이 함께 여는 도시 데이터 실무 포럼의 포스터 3종을 만들어 주세요. 모두 세로 2:3입니다. 한국어와 영어 참석자가 같은 정보를 찾을 수 있어야 합니다. 아래 문구를 한 줄도 빼지 말고 모두 그대로 넣어 주세요. 프로그램, 대상, 신청, 위치를 쉽게 찾게 해 주세요. 신뢰할 수 있고 활기 있는 행사로 보이면 좋겠습니다. 특정 스타일이나 색은 정하지 않겠습니다. 도시의 관찰과 데이터의 관계를 보여 주는 충분한 크기의 비문자 시각 중심이 있어야 합니다. 글자와 여백, 작은 장식만으로 끝내지 말고, 사실이 아닌 지도 정보나 수치는 넣지 말아 주세요.

procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic conversation, I verified the explicitly pinned input byte hashes and read packet.json, case.json, the rules, rubric, ratio policy and the three native-evidence manifests. I actually displayed and visually inspected each exact PNG using tools.view_image with detail='original', emitted through functions.exec, in nine separate calls in this order: R7-B02-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R7-B02-M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R7-B02-M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All nine displays preceded the first transcription judgment, image score and set-diversity judgment. Native dimensions were independently read from PNG IHDR headers. No source assets or protected layouts are declared in the packet. First raw reads below were manually transcribed from the displayed native views after the complete viewing sequence; soft wrapping is retained. There was no genuine unresolved glyph/punctuation ambiguity and no revisit. I do not claim a runtime thread ID or a runner-provenance inspection; session_id remains null.

evidence.observation: The hand-held urban assembly is substantive content-grounded nonglyph imagery, not lettering, texture or a small decoration.

content_form.location: adjoining hand-held urban views with red seam
content_form.observation: The illustration gives the city-reading theme an actual nonglyph operation: two observed urban facets are held and joined into a constructed city representation. Building access, pedestrians and shared public space connect it to everyday/local practice rather than a decorative letter treatment.

content_form.location: large urban assembly below centred bilingual headline
content_form.observation: The hands and joined fields keep the observation/assembly analogy legible without making up map facts or numbers. The abstraction is specific enough to support the data forum, though it does not describe a particular analytic method.

hierarchy.location: top agenda, centred headline/metadata and bottom information cards
hierarchy.observation: Large dark/red bilingual title anchors the composition. Five ruled time rows make the programme easy to find; date and venue are paired under the title, and lower cards put audience and registration in stable positions.

hierarchy.location: title, urban assembly and two lower cards
hierarchy.observation: The title and joining-hands image survive the reduction as two clear focal anchors. Small event metadata and timetable details recede, while the two utility cards remain distinct shapes.

typography.location: top full-width programme rows and centred bilingual title
typography.observation: Hangul and English glyphs remain clear, with bold times and consistent bilingual row spacing. The compact English headline is tightly set but its words remain identifiable; all 24 required entries compare equal.

typography.location: two lower cards, blue URL/contact words and English audience wrap
typography.observation: Body copy and the protected application URLs are readable. English audience wraps across two lines without loss. Blue URL strings contrast against mint without broken slash or word spacing.

space.location: wide top programme band, centred identity and large middle visual
space.observation: The programme occupies a compact ruled band; a centred identity stack bridges it to the large urban pieces. The illustration has enough area to act as the visual centre rather than an icon added to a text poster.

space.location: yellow and mint cards in lower quarter
space.observation: Rounded cards have similar widths and internal padding, a consistent gutter, and enough clearance below the illustrated map edge to keep text intact. The top programme begins close to the upper edge, making that band denser than the lower cards.

image_material.location: hands, folded urban pieces and building/pavement details
image_material.observation: Outlines, planar shading and the isometric urban views share one illustrated language. Hands visibly grip the pieces; building steps, benches, tree planters and walking figures are legible and consistently scaled within the panels.

image_material.location: red join between yellow building field and mint public-space field
image_material.observation: The boundary carries through the adjacent panel edges as a purposeful join. The representation remains schematic, with enough local detail to identify urban activity and no assertion of a real map.

emotion_control.location: active hands, yellow/mint fields and red title word
emotion_control.observation: Holding and joining the city views creates a human, collaborative feeling. Saturated highlights make the event lively, while disciplined navy programme rows and metadata maintain trust.

emotion_control.location: lower paired cards and centred organiser
emotion_control.observation: Clear practical information tempers the playful illustration. The supplied organiser is legible without added institutional badges or sponsor logos.

ai_slop.location: urban panel details and the two gripping hands
ai_slop.observation: Trees, people, bench, lamps and building elements belong to the joined city views rather than floating as arbitrary motifs. The visible hands and folds read coherently, and the red boundary has a compositional function.

ai_slop.location: programme and two lower cards
ai_slop.observation: The rule system and bilingual associations are consistent. No pseudo-statistics, invented map legend, stray labels or visibly corrupted copy appear; the foliage repetition stays within the city scene.

residuals: The urban-data relationship remains an assembly metaphor rather than a depiction of a specific measurement or analytical method; the visible metaphor is sufficient for this open brief.

The programme has a shallow top margin, and the English headline is tightly set. Small date/venue/organiser details become miniature in thumbnail320; title, hands and card structure remain recognizable.

evidence.observation: A tall painted streetscape occupies the left half while one continuous information column occupies the right. Detailed versus pale simplified city forms distinguish its visual mechanism from M2’s architectural montage and M3’s hand-held assembly.

Rendered architectural slices surround a central title/programme, with metadata upper left and two lower utility columns. Its photographic material, framed central opening and distributed reading islands differ from M1’s vertical split and M3’s graphic assembly.

Large outlined hands join yellow/mint urban pieces below a top programme band and centred title, above two coloured cards. The joining action, illustration material and top/middle/bottom organization differ from the other two members.

residuals: All three share navy sans typography, cream reading fields, green urban vegetation and a sunlit built environment. Their material, nonglyph operation and composition change substantially, so the diversity is more than palette substitution, but the shared city imagery limits conceptual breadth.

provenance.viewing_limit: freshness/completion are trace-backed; semantic viewing/order remain critic attestations

evidence.location: architectural montage surrounding the central text, upper right and lower left/right
evidence.observation: A substantive city scene is present, and no fictitious map labels, scales or numeric claims are visible. The separate missing relationship is retained as a failure of the preceding condition.

evidence.observation: One flat RGB opaque portrait poster with complete copy is visible.

conditions.condition: Preserve the complete title/copy; do not invent additional copy, logos, sponsors or labels.

evidence.observation: No supplied copy is omitted, and no extra copy, logos, sponsors or labels are visible.

conditions.condition: A substantive content-grounded non-glyph visual is required; glyph-only output, 3D type alone, texture and token ornament are insufficient.

evidence.location: architectural montage surrounding the central text, upper right and lower left/right
evidence.observation: Buildings, terraces and people supply a large content-grounded nonglyph image. This passes the substantive-content test while the more specific relationship condition fails.

content_form.location: upper-right laptop room, lower-left café group and surrounding buildings
content_form.observation: The people and architectural fragments communicate a pleasant working neighbourhood, including small-group interaction. There is no visible mechanism connecting city observation to data, so the visual could serve a broad urban-work or development event with little change.

content_form.location: central title framed by terraces and greenery
content_form.observation: The framing integrates a large city visual with the title, but the specific urban-data proposition is carried almost entirely by the title and schedule. This is functional, generic content treatment rather than resolved specificity.

hierarchy.location: top-left metadata, central headline/agenda and lower two columns
hierarchy.observation: The headline dominates the central opening, metadata occupies a consistent upper-left island, timed programme rows fill the centre, and labelled audience/application groups occupy the lower islands. All four requested information functions have identifiable homes.

hierarchy.location: centre title versus upper and lower utility groups
hierarchy.observation: The headline stays clearly recognizable despite being placed below metadata. The smaller logistics recede together rather than competing with the title; the architecture frames the reading field.

typography.location: central timed programme rows and bottom bilingual information
typography.observation: Clean navy sans type, bold times and Korean labels, and English continuations give the dense content a consistent system. The audience English wraps across two lines without changing its words.

typography.location: bottom-right deadline, URL and contact rows
typography.observation: Protected URL strings remain unbroken and distinguishable. Body text is readable at this supplied use size; all 24 transcriptions match the declared comparison. Small logistics naturally become difficult to read in thumbnail320.

space.location: central cream opening between architectural slices
space.observation: The diagonal upper terrace, left façade and right cutaway frame a stable headline/programme field. Architecture takes substantial space without covering text.

space.location: bottom information island and vertical divider
space.observation: The audience/admission/capacity group and deadline/application/contact group use separate columns with consistent rules and a clear divider. The surrounding terrace provides a deliberate transition from programme to utility information.

image_material.location: upper-right office cutaway and lower-left outdoor seating
image_material.observation: Rendered masonry, glass, furniture, foliage and sunlight share a coherent material language. The laptop user and seated figures are legible as activities rather than unexplained shapes.

image_material.location: diagonal terrace bands surrounding the central opening
image_material.observation: The buildings are deliberately presented as separated montage slices around a flat text field, rather than as one continuous navigable street. The cut edges and material transitions are controlled; this does not establish a factual map or a data diagram.

emotion_control.location: sunlit greenery, seated groups and walking figures
emotion_control.observation: Social activity and warm light make the event approachable and active, while dark navy type and restrained rules retain a professional tone.

emotion_control.location: central headline and programme field
emotion_control.observation: A quiet cream reading field moderates the dense rendered architecture, keeping the event information credible. The glossy urban-work mood is broader than the data topic, as scored in content_form.

ai_slop.location: architectural slices, foliage and people around the reading field
ai_slop.observation: Repeated vegetation and terrace forms belong to the visible city montage. Cutaway boundaries are consistent compositional edges; no observable invented numeric graphics, pseudo-legends or unsupported sponsor marks appear.

ai_slop.location: central programme and bottom contact/application field
ai_slop.observation: The schedule has one stable time column and retained bilingual associations. Copy and URLs are clean, with no gibberish or stray labels. The lack of a specific data relationship is retained as a content and mandatory-style failure rather than inferred as a medium defect.

residuals: The substantive visual is a city-and-work montage, but the mandatory relationship between observing the city and data is not visible. Style FAIL remains even though all copy and the native ratio pass.
Application and contact have similar navy emphasis in the small bottom-right column. The groups are readable at usage720 but do not survive as individually readable detail in thumbnail320.

procedure.method: Fresh independent review. I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, runner and summarizer, and read the three pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded source/input/final paths. Python SHA-256 and PNG IHDR checks matched the declared bytes and dimensions. The packet has no supplied source assets or protected-layout manifests. I then actually displayed each of the nine exact pinned PNGs, in packet member order M1, M2, M3 and native, usage720, thumbnail320 order within each, using tools.view_image through functions.exec and image(..., original) at original detail. These nine displays were complete before the first transcription comparison, image score or diversity score. Transcriptions below are my first raw readings retained from those displays; no ambiguity revisit was needed. No external source, prior review, author intent, or runtime thread identifier was used.

hierarchy.location: top agenda above headline and central event stack
hierarchy.observation: Five bold, full-width agenda rows occupy the top before the identity block. Title, forum, date, venue and organiser then stack in a compact central pocket, requiring the reader to move back upward from the title to the programme.

hierarchy.location: centre metadata between title and illustration
hierarchy.observation: The title remains strong, but date, location and organiser compress into several small centred lines between it and the large folded scene. Their priority is weaker than both timetable and illustration.

typography.location: top programme rows and central bilingual title
typography.observation: The programme preserves all bilingual wording in aligned single-line rows. The Korean headline is bold and clear; the English title uses a dense bold line with a red Data emphasis.

typography.location: two bottom cards
typography.observation: The audience translation wraps onto two readable lines; deadline, protected URLs and email remain clearly separated, with complete Hangul and Latin text.

space.location: top edge and central identity pocket
space.observation: The first programme row starts only about 17 pixels below the top. After the agenda, the large title and seven smaller identity/organiser lines pack into the irregular white opening above the folded scene; that opening gives the venue little breathing room.

space.location: bottom cards versus upper central stack
space.observation: The two spacious rounded cards have generous internal margins, while the upper centre is substantially denser. This uneven allocation leaves the key date/venue less comfortably spaced than the support details.

image_material.location: folded scene, hands and central seam
image_material.observation: Strong outlines, shaded hands, yellow facade, mint street panel and small pedestrians share one illustration language. Fold edges and the red separating seam remain legible, and paving perspective gives the spatial model depth.

emotion_control.location: whole poster
emotion_control.observation: Yellow and mint panels, blue clothing/links and red title emphasis produce an active workshop-like mood. The large act of handling the city representation makes participation concrete, with navy rules retaining a professional register.

ai_slop.location: central illustration and bottom cards
ai_slop.observation: Hands visibly grip the folded edges, buildings and benches remain recognisable, and the scene uses no fabricated place names, scale, coordinates or numerical data. The red line follows the fold boundary and is not labelled as a real route.

content_form.location: left half, detailed street beside a pale repeat of its forms
content_form.observation: The specific city setting is clear, and the adjacent reduced forms suggest abstraction, but the shift has little visible structure that identifies what is being learned or represented as data.

hierarchy.location: right column from title through date, venue, schedule and application
hierarchy.observation: The large bilingual title leads to clearly separated event, venue, timed programme and attendance blocks. Orange registration lines make the action easy to locate.

hierarchy.location: top-right title and orange lower-right link
hierarchy.observation: The title and application accent survive reduction; the many supporting lines become small, but the main reading structure remains visible.

typography.location: right column bilingual schedule and supporting copy
typography.observation: Hangul and Latin forms are clean; times occupy a stable left rail and longer English programme names wrap under their Korean names. All required glyphs and punctuation were observed.

typography.location: audience line and last programme row at right edge
typography.observation: The longest lines sit close to the right margin but remain readable and do not collide or clip. Consistent dark-blue type and clear weight changes provide professional handling.

space.location: full composition, illustrated left strip and right information column
space.observation: A stable vertical division reserves roughly half the width for illustration while the right column shares consistent left edges and repeated thin separator rules.

space.location: right-column blocks from schedule to organiser
space.observation: Intervals between programme, audience, application, contact and organiser are systematic; the lower organiser retains a clear bottom inset.

image_material.location: left foreground tree, orange entrance and pavement shadows
image_material.observation: Painterly foliage, bark, window planes and sunlit paving share a coherent illustrated material; the near tree and receding street remain legible.

image_material.location: centre-left pale blue street and white contour edges
image_material.observation: The simplified planes continue the street direction coherently; the material transition is controlled even though its data meaning is weak.

emotion_control.location: green canopy, warm orange facade and navy information column
emotion_control.observation: Fresh greenery and a warm street generate an inviting, lively daytime mood, while the ordered navy copy keeps the forum credible.

emotion_control.location: overall colour and title relationship
emotion_control.observation: The bright image does not overpower the title or action accent; the emotional effect is controlled and suitable for an accessible public event.

ai_slop.location: tree trunk, facade edges and schedule column
ai_slop.observation: The scene has consistent construction and the information column has no observable invented labels, malformed copy or stray icons.

ai_slop.location: illustration/text boundary and repeated horizontal rules
ai_slop.observation: The visual boundary and separators are deliberate and coherent; no unresolved generated defect stands out. The weak data specificity is recorded in content_form rather than inferred as an artifact.

residuals: The visual city/data relationship remains underdeveloped; the first two palette/rendering treatments should not be mistaken for visible data simply because the title mentions it.
The longest right-column supporting lines have limited breathing room, and fine supporting text is small at thumbnail scale.

content_form.location: central joined yellow/mint city fragments held by two hands
content_form.observation: The city is made into two manipulable spatial records. Joining them supplies an observable connection between local observation, shared information and small-team collaboration, rather than only illustrating a street.

content_form.location: middle visual spanning most of the width
content_form.observation: The hands, coloured fragments and red seam stay visible as the main nonglyph concept. The information-assembly relationship is specific enough to support the supplied mapping and collaboration programme.

hierarchy.location: top programme, central bilingual title/logistics and bottom cards
hierarchy.observation: The programme is immediately accessible at the top; the larger title below it anchors the event, followed by venue/date, while two coloured bottom cards separate audience from registration.

hierarchy.location: central title and yellow/mint lower panels
hierarchy.observation: The title and diagram form a strong central focus, with the programme strip clearly separate. Date and organiser are subordinate and relatively small, preventing an exceptional hierarchy score.

typography.location: top five timed rows and central bilingual title
typography.observation: Clean bilingual forms and stable aligned times make the schedule readable. Red emphasis on 데이터/Data is consistent across languages; all literal copy was observed.

typography.location: bottom panels and compact English title
typography.observation: The long English audience entry wraps into two lines while the registration URLs remain intact. The English title is tightly set and the logistics stack is compact, but neither is clipped or confused with illustration.

space.location: full-width programme and diagonal central diagram
space.observation: The top rules share aligned ends, the title/logistics occupy the open notch above the two city fragments, and the diagonal composition gives the substantial visual room.

space.location: bottom yellow and mint cards
space.observation: Matched rounded panels, a clear central gutter and repeated inner rules establish orderly attendance and application areas. The diagram approaches the card tops closely but does not cover the copy.

image_material.location: two hands, black-edged city panels and red seam
image_material.observation: Outlined hands, flat shaded city surfaces and diagram edges share a consistent illustrated language. Fingers visibly grip the fragments; the seam remains clear through the paving and facade.

image_material.location: central trees, bench, lamp and pedestrians
image_material.observation: Small urban elements remain coherent at a consistent diagram scale, with readable pathways and distinct figures. The image functions as an illustrative spatial model without claiming a named real map.

emotion_control.location: yellow/mint city pieces, red title emphasis and blue links
emotion_control.observation: The bright, contrasting accents produce an energetic and approachable mood; paired language blocks and the ruled schedule keep the practical forum tone credible.

emotion_control.location: two hands bringing local scenes together
emotion_control.observation: A visible shared action conveys participation and collaborative work without needing to infer an unseen narrative from the title.

ai_slop.location: right hand grip and joined urban diagrams
ai_slop.observation: The hands connect to the panels, city furniture fits the representation, and the red seam has a consistent compositional role rather than appearing as arbitrary decoration.

ai_slop.location: programme, central logistics and bottom registration panel
ai_slop.observation: No extraneous sponsor, legend, fabricated statistic or stray label is visible. Repeated tree shapes are part of the city depiction, and the copy blocks remain orderly.

residuals: The English title and central logistics stack are tightly set; date, venue and organiser are subordinate to the programme and central image.

The spatial representation communicates shared local observation, but offers no explicit data-analysis process; this limits exceptional specificity without invalidating the visible content relationship.

evidence.observation: A painterly vertical street strip sits beside a single right information column; the rendered-to-pale street treatment differs materially and spatially from M2 and M3.

Rendered architectural cutaways enclose a central title/programme opening, with top-left logistics and a two-column footer. This is a different image construction and reading structure from M1, rather than only a palette substitution.
Two hands join outlined yellow/mint urban fragments, below a full-width programme and above coloured attendance cards. Its active diagram concept and composition differ from both scenic posters.

residuals: All three return to leafy architecture and similar dark sans-serif bilingual type; the set is meaningfully varied in concept, rendering and composition, but not exceptionally wide in visual vocabulary.
M1 and M2 retain observed content/style weaknesses; set diversity does not cancel those failures.

content_form.location: left half, detailed street beside a pale repeat of its forms
content_form.observation: The specific city setting is clear, and the adjacent reduced forms suggest abstraction, but the shift has little visible structure that identifies what is being learned or represented as data.

content_form.location: left visual strip beside the right text column
content_form.observation: At small scale it reads chiefly as a tree-lined neighbourhood illustration. The city-to-data connection depends heavily on the title; the content relationship remains generic, warranting 3.

hierarchy.location: right column from title through date, venue, schedule and application
hierarchy.observation: The large bilingual title leads to clearly separated event, venue, timed programme and attendance blocks. Orange registration lines make the action easy to locate.

hierarchy.location: top-right title and orange lower-right link
hierarchy.observation: The title and application accent survive reduction; the many supporting lines become small, but the main reading structure remains visible.

typography.location: right column bilingual schedule and supporting copy
typography.observation: Hangul and Latin forms are clean; times occupy a stable left rail and longer English programme names wrap under their Korean names. All required glyphs and punctuation were observed.

typography.location: audience line and last programme row at right edge
typography.observation: The longest lines sit close to the right margin but remain readable and do not collide or clip. Consistent dark-blue type and clear weight changes provide professional handling.

space.location: full composition, illustrated left strip and right information column
space.observation: A stable vertical division reserves roughly half the width for illustration while the right column shares consistent left edges and repeated thin separator rules.

space.location: right-column blocks from schedule to organiser
space.observation: Intervals between programme, audience, application, contact and organiser are systematic; the lower organiser retains a clear bottom inset.

image_material.location: left foreground tree, orange entrance and pavement shadows
image_material.observation: Painterly foliage, bark, window planes and sunlit paving share a coherent illustrated material; the near tree and receding street remain legible.

image_material.location: centre-left pale blue street and white contour edges
image_material.observation: The simplified planes continue the street direction coherently; the material transition is controlled even though its data meaning is weak.

emotion_control.location: green canopy, warm orange facade and navy information column
emotion_control.observation: Fresh greenery and a warm street generate an inviting, lively daytime mood, while the ordered navy copy keeps the forum credible.

emotion_control.location: overall colour and title relationship
emotion_control.observation: The bright image does not overpower the title or action accent; the emotional effect is controlled and suitable for an accessible public event.

ai_slop.location: tree trunk, facade edges and schedule column
ai_slop.observation: The scene has consistent construction and the information column has no observable invented labels, malformed copy or stray icons.

ai_slop.location: illustration/text boundary and repeated horizontal rules
ai_slop.observation: The visual boundary and separators are deliberate and coherent; no unresolved generated defect stands out. The weak data specificity is recorded in content_form rather than inferred as an artifact.

residuals: The visual city/data relationship remains underdeveloped; the first two palette/rendering treatments should not be mistaken for visible data simply because the title mentions it.
The longest right-column supporting lines have limited breathing room, and fine supporting text is small at thumbnail scale.

content_form.location: upper-right laptop table and lower-left seated group
content_form.observation: Work, conversation and pedestrian scenes fit a small professional gathering, but the prominent imagery is a generic planted architectural environment.

content_form.location: architectural frame surrounding the title and schedule
content_form.observation: No visible representation connects city observation to data; the cutaway buildings serve mainly as a scenic frame. The essential topic relies on copy, so this dimension is functional but generic: 3.

hierarchy.location: central title/schedule, top-left logistics and bottom two-column footer
hierarchy.observation: The central title is the main focus, timed rows read sequentially, and logistics and registration occupy distinct regions. Korean and English are paired within each region.

hierarchy.location: centre title contrasted with top-left forum heading
hierarchy.observation: The central title remains strongest despite the large upper-left heading; the footer is much smaller but retains a visible two-column structure.

space.location: central cream opening and architectural fragments around its perimeter
space.observation: The buildings and foliage form an intentional irregular frame; the central schedule occupies a stable opening rather than sitting on detailed textures.

space.location: bottom audience and application columns
space.observation: A vertical divider separates the two information groups, and aligned thin rules keep their internal spacing consistent despite the irregular image perimeter.

image_material.location: upper-right terrace, concrete planters and orange structural sections
image_material.observation: Sunlight, concrete surfaces, foliage and warm orange sections share a coherent rendered material; table/chair scale and the laptop user are readable.

image_material.location: lower-left cafe and right-side walking figure
image_material.observation: People and furniture remain locally legible. The exposed architectural segments clearly operate as a poster collage; this assessment does not impose a ban on rendered or impossible cutaway compositions.

emotion_control.location: lit cafe scene and bright green architectural frame
emotion_control.observation: People working, talking and walking in sunny planted space create a welcoming and active tone appropriate to a professional community gathering.

emotion_control.location: cream centre with navy title and timed programme
emotion_control.observation: The restrained information field balances the lush surroundings and gives the event credibility instead of reducing it to decorative scenery alone.

ai_slop.location: upper terrace, foreground pedestrians and programme rules
ai_slop.observation: The figures, building segments and ruled schedule show no conspicuous malformed appendage, stray label or copy corruption. The repeated plants belong to the urban setting.

ai_slop.location: whole cutaway frame
ai_slop.observation: The collage maintains an intentional shape at small size; repetition of greenery is thematically consistent. Topic genericness is a content problem, not evidence of an invented production defect.

typography.location: central timed rows and bottom bilingual audience block
typography.observation: Times, Korean names and English translations maintain aligned readable roles; the audience translation wraps after practitioners without losing words.

typography.location: bottom registration/contact lines and top-left logistics
typography.observation: The smallest English lines remain readable at use size, and the long deadline line stays inside its block. At thumbnail size fine copy is small, but the major title remains clear.

residuals: The urban-data topic depends on the lettering; the inhabited architectural frame could equally illustrate a workspace or neighbourhood event.
The central title is clear, but the dense bottom footer is considerably smaller than the image and title at thumbnail scale.

content_form.location: central joined yellow/mint city fragments held by two hands
content_form.observation: The city is made into two manipulable spatial records. Joining them supplies an observable connection between local observation, shared information and small-team collaboration, rather than only illustrating a street.

content_form.location: middle visual spanning most of the width
content_form.observation: The hands, coloured fragments and red seam stay visible as the main nonglyph concept. The information-assembly relationship is specific enough to support the supplied mapping and collaboration programme.

hierarchy.location: top programme, central bilingual title/logistics and bottom cards
hierarchy.observation: The programme is immediately accessible at the top; the larger title below it anchors the event, followed by venue/date, while two coloured bottom cards separate audience from registration.

hierarchy.location: central title and yellow/mint lower panels
hierarchy.observation: The title and diagram form a strong central focus, with the programme strip clearly separate. Date and organiser are subordinate and relatively small, preventing an exceptional hierarchy score.

typography.location: top five timed rows and central bilingual title
typography.observation: Clean bilingual forms and stable aligned times make the schedule readable. Red emphasis on 데이터/Data is consistent across languages; all literal copy was observed.

typography.location: bottom panels and compact English title
typography.observation: The long English audience entry wraps into two lines while the registration URLs remain intact. The English title is tightly set and the logistics stack is compact, but neither is clipped or confused with illustration.

space.location: full-width programme and diagonal central diagram
space.observation: The top rules share aligned ends, the title/logistics occupy the open notch above the two city fragments, and the diagonal composition gives the substantial visual room.

space.location: bottom yellow and mint cards
space.observation: Matched rounded panels, a clear central gutter and repeated inner rules establish orderly attendance and application areas. The diagram approaches the card tops closely but does not cover the copy.

image_material.location: two hands, black-edged city panels and red seam
image_material.observation: Outlined hands, flat shaded city surfaces and diagram edges share a consistent illustrated language. Fingers visibly grip the fragments; the seam remains clear through the paving and facade.

image_material.location: central trees, bench, lamp and pedestrians
image_material.observation: Small urban elements remain coherent at a consistent diagram scale, with readable pathways and distinct figures. The image functions as an illustrative spatial model without claiming a named real map.

emotion_control.location: yellow/mint city pieces, red title emphasis and blue links
emotion_control.observation: The bright, contrasting accents produce an energetic and approachable mood; paired language blocks and the ruled schedule keep the practical forum tone credible.

emotion_control.location: two hands bringing local scenes together
emotion_control.observation: A visible shared action conveys participation and collaborative work without needing to infer an unseen narrative from the title.

ai_slop.location: right hand grip and joined urban diagrams
ai_slop.observation: The hands connect to the panels, city furniture fits the representation, and the red seam has a consistent compositional role rather than appearing as arbitrary decoration.

ai_slop.location: programme, central logistics and bottom registration panel
ai_slop.observation: No extraneous sponsor, legend, fabricated statistic or stray label is visible. Repeated tree shapes are part of the city depiction, and the copy blocks remain orderly.

residuals: The English title and central logistics stack are tightly set; date, venue and organiser are subordinate to the programme and central image.

The spatial representation communicates shared local observation, but offers no explicit data-analysis process; this limits exceptional specificity without invalidating the visible content relationship.

evidence.observation: A painterly vertical street strip sits beside a single right information column; the rendered-to-pale street treatment differs materially and spatially from M2 and M3.

Rendered architectural cutaways enclose a central title/programme opening, with top-left logistics and a two-column footer. This is a different image construction and reading structure from M1, rather than only a palette substitution.
Two hands join outlined yellow/mint urban fragments, below a full-width programme and above coloured attendance cards. Its active diagram concept and composition differ from both scenic posters.

residuals: All three return to leafy architecture and similar dark sans-serif bilingual type; the set is meaningfully varied in concept, rendering and composition, but not exceptionally wide in visual vocabulary.
M1 and M2 retain observed content/style weaknesses; set diversity does not cancel those failures.
